authority: Parent integration owner must freeze the full new source and independently qualify the guards before GO. Included local resources only; no paid models, keys, spending, external outreach, real contracts, private user data or physical operations.
changes_requiring_qualification_before_e: Version2 public service schema binds imported helpers, acceptance, package initializers and tape-lock dependency in its source closure.

Version2 uses the already implemented exact source/account-bound native prefix-replay mechanism. Current outputs, source identity, account ownership, native prefix, commitments, obligations and acceptance remain checked; no financial guard is removed.
The source-distribution inventory includes the portfolio implementation and verifier dependencies.

This controller schedules independent scenarios with exclusive per-case reservations and at most four local worker processes. The original price, cost, task, capital, horizon, buyer, rights, scientific-approval and accounting rules are unchanged.
claim_boundary: Hypothetical initial equity remains an assumption, not secured funds or income. Rights-unresolved primary cases still refuse licensing, absent approved scientific products still forbid offers, no physical output is sold, and unknown model/host billing remains null. Source qualification does not establish demand, new industry, actual commerce, autonomous invention, a more consequential successor or the USD3b profit objective.
evidence: Every completed case retains its original canonical audit_journal result, public export, manifest, decisions, costs, obligations, monthly history and exact trailing365-day observer. An independent verifier checks the registered financial conditions separately. Results/REPORT use the same case schema and deterministic planned ordering despite parallel completion. Record controller and worker actual CPU/wall/peak-RSS telemetry, source/protocol/amendment identities, actual worker allocation and code commit.
failure_and_stopping: No automatic retries. At the first worker failure stop scheduling new cases, let already-running independent accounts finish and close normally, and retain all successful/failed reservations, public results and private recovery state. Produce CHECKPOINT and PARTIAL_RESULTS with all registered, completed, failed and not-started case IDs; never produce complete RESULTS on a partial campaign. A source/guard failure is a checkpoint, not a pass. No reset, hidden top-up, copied balance, pooled profit or substituted scenario.

plan.account_namespaces: Each R2 case has its own new output/private/case-id directory and native account. The output directory must not already exist. R1 account bytes, recovery material, balances and liabilities are never read as funding or copied into R2.
plan.entry_point: The unchanged economics._run_case and economics._compact implement every scenario; the controller does not replace financial state or calculate a second company ledger.
plan.future_truth: Completion order never changes a scenario, utility, source artifact, rule or price grid. No early stopping on profit or favorable outcomes.
plan.ownership: One worker owns each exclusive reservation and one native account. Per-case mkdir(exist_ok=False), source-bound native ownership and original idempotency guards remain active. Shared product source is immutable; delivery paths are distinct by case.
plan.runtime_worker_count: min(4, observed CPU affinity count, floor of cgroup CPU quota where present), at least1; record actual resource query. This is an execution allocation, not a universal business/capital ceiling.
plan.scenario_order: Exactly ECONOMICS_PROTOCOL.registered_scenarios order within each listed route

r1_status: Original scientific/financial source and simulated accounts remain intact. The original partial financial campaign is stopped only at an account boundary after the current case completes. Public-source review found that production060.service and its acceptance dependency were omitted from the adapter closure. Existing unchanged-helper arithmetic is useful, but R1 full executable source-closure qualification FAILED. R1 failures, complete/partial denominators, costs, receipts and obligations are not erased or relabeled.
r2_purpose: Reproduce all registered finite financial comparisons under a prospectively qualified source closure and existing exact prefix-replay mechanism. This is an engineering/source-qualification reproduction, not new blinded economic calibration, continuation of an R1 business, a migration, or an opportunity to choose favorable worlds.
